excerpt.zh: Gemini 4 Argon主打百万令牌上下文与长程推理，覆盖软件工程、企业知识工作和网络防御，但目前仍处于受限测试与安全评估阶段。
excerpt.en: Gemini 4 Argon combines a one-million-token limit with long-horizon reasoning for coding, enterprise work, and cyber defense, but access remains limited during safety testing.

text.zh: Gemini 4 Argon瞄准复杂长程任务
Gemini 4 Argon是Google宣布的新一代前沿模型，重点处理需要多步推理、持续执行和跨文档理解的专业任务。Google称，它已用于内部软件工程、研究和写作流程，并计划先通过Fairwind计划向受信任的网络防御人员开放。
text.en: Gemini 4 Argon is Google’s new frontier model for professional tasks that require multi-step reasoning, sustained execution, and understanding across documents. Google says it is already used internally for software engineering, research, and writing, while initial external access is going to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program.

text.zh: 百万令牌上下文扩展企业应用
模型的输出令牌上限从此前的6.4万提升至100万，定位包括大型代码库迁移、金融研究、法律起草、图表与长视频分析。Google还报告称，Argon在若干内部或合作方评测中取得领先结果，例如DeepSWE v1.1得分77.9%，AutomationBench得分51.3%。这些数字反映特定基准表现，不等同于所有真实工作流中的稳定收益。
text.en: The model’s output limit rises from 64,000 to one million tokens. Google positions it for large codebase migrations, financial research, legal drafting, chart and long-video analysis, and other enterprise workflows. The company reports leading results on selected internal or partner evaluations, including 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 51.3% on AutomationBench. Such scores describe benchmark performance, not guaranteed gains in every real-world workflow.

text.zh: 网络防御能力与发布限制

在网络安全方面，Google表示Argon能够发现、验证并修补软件漏洞，并称其在CWE-bench v1上以68%并列第一。Wiz也通过公益项目测试该模型。不过，Google尚未全面开放产品，而是在扩大访问前继续进行红队测试、滥用防护和提示注入防御。真正重要的开放问题是：如此长的自主执行链能否在复杂环境中保持可验证、可控和安全。Google给出的初始价格为每百万输入令牌2美元、输出令牌10美元，缓存输入另有折扣。
text.en: For cybersecurity, Google says Argon can find, validate, and patch software vulnerabilities, tying for first on CWE-bench v1 with a 68% score. Wiz is also testing it through a public-interest program. Broad release has not happened: Google is continuing red-team work, misuse safeguards, and prompt-injection defenses. The central open question is whether such long autonomous task chains can remain verifiable, controllable, and safe in complex environments. Google lists introductory pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with a separate discount for cached inputs.
